sale_discounts_courtesy_full_line.name: sale_discounts_courtesy_full_line
sale_discounts_courtesy_full_line.value: "sale_discounts"."kind" <> 'courtesy' OR ("sale_discounts"."mode" = 'percent' AND "sale_discounts"."value" = 10000 AND "sale_discounts"."sale_line_id" IS NOT NULL)

sale_lines_kind_reference.name: sale_lines_kind_reference
sale_lines_kind_reference.value: ("sale_lines"."kind" = 'service' AND "sale_lines"."service_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sale_lines"."product_id" IS NULL) OR ("sale_lines"."kind" = 'product' AND "sale_lines"."product_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sale_lines"."service_id" IS NULL)

sale_payments_cash_consistent.name: sale_payments_cash_consistent
sale_payments_cash_consistent.value: ("sale_payments"."tendered_cents" IS NULL AND "sale_payments"."change_cents" IS NULL) OR ("sale_payments"."tendered_cents" >= "sale_payments"."amount_cents" AND "sale_payments"."change_cents" = "sale_payments"."tendered_cents" - "sale_payments"."amount_cents")
